title: Why Do Bananas Ripen Faster? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
Put raw bananas in a closed box with a ripe fruit and they ripen faster. Diya asks: what passes from the ripe fruit to the raw ones, and what tells a plant to stop and wait?

We see how cytokinins were found in tobacco callus, what kinetin and zeatin are and what cytokinins do, then ethylene from Cousins' oranges and bananas to the respiratory climacteric and ethephon on the farm. Then abscisic acid, a zoom from a leaf to its stomata to one closing stoma, ethylene vs ABA on a seed with a pause and think, a worked example, the exam trap about kinetin, an original NEET pattern statement question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 94 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.
